label: Demo data: Amberkloof is an invented brand · category-only request, no website

request.category: small-batch botanical body care (marula face oil, rooibos body butter)

target.note: The hero brand Amberkloof is invented and has no website; the request names its category and area only (PROVISIONAL, spine D-06).

text:
**Assumptions:** No site yet, so this is a new build. The template is e-commerce with a local flavour. Budget is small, with the owner doing the work. There are no named competitors, so I'm using generic ones: Pretoria boutique brands, Faithful to Nature and Takealot sellers. I did no live research, so every keyword is a hypothesis to check in Search Console and Keyword Planner.

**Goal:** more enquiries and orders from Google and AI assistants.

| Window | Priorities | Pages to fix or build | Target keywords |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Days 1–30: Foundation** | Build a fast, mobile-first shop (Shopify or WooCommerce). Claim and complete the Google Business Profile for Pretoria East. Set up GA4, Search Console and a WhatsApp enquiry button. Allow AI crawlers in robots.txt. | Home, Shop, Marula face oil, Rooibos body butter, About (maker story and ingredient sourcing), Contact/Delivery, FAQ. Add Product, Organization, LocalBusiness and FAQ schema. | "marula oil face oil South Africa", "rooibos body butter", "natural skincare Pretoria", "handmade body care Pretoria East" |
| **Days 31–60: Expansion** | Collect reviews and show them on product pages. Add ingredient and "who it's for" detail. Publish answer-first guides that AI assistants can quote. List on local directories and Google Merchant Center (free listings). | 4 guides: "Marula oil benefits for skin", "Rooibos for dry skin and eczema-prone skin", "Marula oil vs argan oil", "How to use body butter". Add a Pretoria East delivery and collection page and a gift sets page. | "marula oil benefits for skin", "marula oil vs argan oil", "rooibos skincare benefits", "natural skincare gifts South Africa" |
| **Days 61–90: Scale** | Earn links and mentions from SA beauty bloggers, markets, and "best of" lists. Add a Google Business Profile post cadence. Check the AI-citation baseline by asking ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini the target queries monthly. Improve pages by impressions and click-through rate. | Collection pages by concern (dry skin, mature skin, sensitive skin). Ingredient glossary. Wholesale/stockist page. Comparison and "best of" pages. | "best natural face oil South Africa", "small batch skincare Gauteng", "handmade skincare gift Pretoria", "wholesale natural skincare SA" |

**Targets by day 90:** 15 to 20 indexed pages, 10 or more reviews, GBP live, and the first non-branded clicks in Search Console.

**Next:** Decide the platform (Shopify or WooCommerce), then build the Marula face oil product page first.
